snippet.title: Other Tower Dev-Log 5: Final CYOP Release
snippet.description:
We finished it! Try the final CYOP version of Other Tower Now!

Other Tower is a Pizza Tower CYOP/AFOM Custom Tower, containing Po-Boy Bayou, Golf 2, Idaho Volcano, and eventually Capitalism Causeway.

Download Other Tower here! (Requires latest version of AFOM V1)
https://gamebanana.com/mods/446545

Join the Other Tower Discord server here!
https://discord.gg/xX3zd685AC
